names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 18 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Κύριλλος του Αστραχάν», with the rank word left off.

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Κύριλλος κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το έτος 1576 μ.Χ.», and the page heads him «(; - 1576)», leaving the first date a question mark. It places his life «κατά τον 16ο αιώνα μ.Χ. στη Ρωσία».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026). The Greek page makes him a Russian abbot, so a Russian row is likely and has not been read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).
